name: Phalanx
author: E. T. Carter
description: A regiment of small octahedra marching out of the fog toward you — an endless lattice of solids, each cell tumbling on its own, dimming into depth so the field reads as deep parallax rather than a flat grid.

params.label: Density
params.effect: How tightly packed the lattice is; low spaces the solids out, high crowds the frame.

params.label: Drift
params.effect: Speed the field flows toward the camera; 0 freezes the formation.

params.label: Fog
params.effect: Depth haze — low keeps far solids crisp, high swallows them so only the front rank shows.

params.label: Tilt
params.effect: Per-cell tumble and camera lean, from a rigid grid to a loose, animated swarm.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer steers the camera through the field; 0 ignores the mouse.
